Pay your healthcare costs easily

Enter your invoice payment reference below. You can then pay safely and quickly online with iDEAL | Wero, first download your full invoice as a PDF, or request a payment arrangement.

Check account status Payment options & help Service & Contact

There are fake emails and fake text messages in circulation.

Criminals are currently sending large numbers of fake emails. The emails often have a title such as 'Outstanding debt,' but there are hundreds of other subjects in circulation. Are you unsure about a suspicious message? Do not click on links and do not make any payment.

We never send you an SMS requesting payment. We only send an SMS when downloading your bill or when you are speaking to our support team on the phone. Any other SMS is an attempt to scam you.

We will also never call you about an outstanding bill. These calls are always fake.

Real or fake?

On our Fake Emails and Phishing page, we show you how to recognize genuine messages from Infomedics. Are you unsure about a message? Then use the Phishing Checker.

More about fake emails and phishing

How it works

Received an invoice from Infomedics? This is how it works.
1

Visit to healthcare provider

Have you visited a healthcare provider, received treatment, or taken medication? In that case, you often do not need to pay immediately. Instead, you will receive an invoice from Infomedics later. This is because your healthcare provider has chosen to outsource the handling of the payment to Infomedics.

More about your account
2

We first check for reimbursement.

Before sending you an invoice, we usually, but not always, check with your health insurer whether you are entitled to reimbursement. After this check, we will only send you an invoice for the amount that has not been reimbursed – your own contribution.

Everything about reimbursements
3

We will send you an invoice

Your healthcare provider determines how we send you the bill. Increasingly often by email, sometimes still in the pink envelope. Emails can sometimes end up in your spam folder. So keep a close eye on this and add Infomedics as a trusted sender. That way, you will never miss our emails.

Everything about receiving your bill
4

Pay bill: immediately, later, or in installments

You can pay your bill with iDEAL | Wero on our online payment page. Unable to pay the full amount immediately? You can easily request a deferral or payment arrangement yourself.

View all payment options
5

If you are late with payment

You have 30 days to pay the original bill. Are you late? Then you will receive a reminder by email or letter. We do not charge any extra costs for the first reminder, but we do for the second reminder.

Read more about our debt collection process

How can we help you?

Our support team answers your questions quickly. Using the payment reference on your healthcare bill, we can immediately help you with a payment deferral, a payment arrangement, or checking the status of your account.

Explanation of payment options

You can pay in various ways: directly, later, or in installments. We'd be happy to tell you about the options.

Status of your account

We locate your account, inform you of the status of our collection process, and provide you with the payment options.

If you cannot pay

We check what is possible for your account and immediately request a deferral or payment arrangement for you.

Are you unsure about an email?

Check if an email is real or fake. Get in touch if you're not sure.

Arrange a payment plan

With our payment plan, you pay the amount automatically in up to 5 installments at no extra cost.

Copy or overview of account(s)

Need an overview of your bills for tax purposes or your health insurer? We'll help you get started.

Frequently Asked Questions

Question about your healthcare bill? Find the answer among our frequently asked questions.

How do I get an overview of my accounts?

Would you like an overview of your bills? We are happy to help. You can often compile the overview yourself. This is easiest if you receive your bills digitally.

Overview of digital accounts

If you already receive all invoices digitally, you can search for 'infomedics' in your email inbox. Click on the blue buttons in the emails to go to the payment page and, if desired, download the full invoice as a PDF.

Pay close attention to the payment references and amounts to distinguish between invoices. Each invoice has its own payment reference. Please note that you may find multiple emails regarding the same invoice; this is the case if we have emailed you a reminder or a demand for payment. The original email, the reminder, and the demand for payment all contain the same payment reference. 

Overview of paper bills

Do you receive your bills by post? Even then, you can often still download them if you know the payment reference. You can find the payment references for paid bills on your bank statement. It is the 14-digit number ending in 071. You can enter the references one by one below.

If downloading fails

Do you not see an option to download the bill? Then request an overview using the contact form. You can do this using the button below. An employee will try to respond to your request within 5 days.

Tip : Download future bills immediately and save them in a folder on your device. This way, you can always view the bills later and use them for your tax return or claim with your health insurer.

Why was my bill not reimbursed by my health insurer?

If your bill has not been reimbursed by your health insurer, there may be several reasons. For example: you have already received your maximum reimbursement or your treatment is not fully reimbursed. For more information, please contact your health insurer. Unfortunately, Infomedics cannot answer questions regarding your reimbursement.

More about reimbursements

Have I paid my bill?

Would you like to know if your payment has been received and processed? Or what the status of an outstanding invoice is?

Click the button below to open the chat window. Enter your payment reference and our support team will help you further.

Why do I need to download my bill?

We cannot send your invoice unsecured as an email attachment. The invoice contains personal and medical information, such as your home address and treatments. Others are not permitted to view this information. Therefore, you can only download the full invoice after verification via SMS.

If you do not receive an SMS after a few minutes and the phone number is correct, there may be a technical issue. Please try again later, request a one-time paper copy, or contact our service desk . Is the phone number incorrect? Then you must have this corrected by your healthcare provider. You can request a one-time paper copy to verify that your bill is correct before paying.

Can I change my email address and/or phone number?

You can only change your email address or mobile phone number with your healthcare provider. Infomedics receives your details from your healthcare provider with every bill. We do not maintain our own file of personal data and therefore cannot change any data for you.
